name: Saulo Carvalho
bio: Saulo Carvalho is a Brazilian filmmaker, camera operator, and cinematographer. He directed A Última Oração (2025) and Eco (2024), and has worked as camera operator and director of photography on projects such as Borboleta (2024), Cinemas de Rua (2024), and Whey: Uma Saga Anabólica em Busca da Verdade (2023).

credits.title: Eu, a Kombi e a Garotinha que Encontrei no Meio do Caminho
credits.overview: Marcela decides to hit the road after an encounter with a fortune teller. Along the way, she meets Lia, and the journey takes on new meaning. Amid changing landscapes and encounters, they embark on a path that changes their lives.

credits.title: The Boom Killer
credits.overview: A great tragedy occurs during the filming of a movie. In an unexpected twist, the renowned Detective Bones takes on the case, as he can sniff out that something isn’t right.

credits.title: The Last Prayer
credits.overview: Caio is a deeply religious young man, living in the shadow of his brother, Alberto. While Alberto challenges norms and embraces life, Caio feels trapped by his beliefs. In a moment of desperation, Caio murders Alberto and stages his death as a suicide, convincing himself that he acted in God’s name.

credits.title: Butterfly
credits.overview: Lelê deals with the loss of someone close, navigating through pain and grief until finding new meaning and peace.

credits.title: Street Cinemas
credits.overview: Explore the significance and impact of São Paulo’s iconic street cinemas. The documentary shows how these venues have shaped the city’s cultural experience and become enduring gathering spots for the local community.

credits.title: Echo
credits.overview: Gabriel is a depressed young man living a reclusive and lonely life, shaken by memories of a very turbulent past. Amid the corona-virus pandemic that is ravaging the world, Gabriel finds refuge in his passion for video games and decides to start a modest career in live broadcasts on the internet. credits.overview: A Whey Protein was stolen inside a fraternity of boys. An investigation begins to discover the real person responsible for the theft.
